parts.title: The Secret Diner and the Hundred Floor Drop — Part 1

series.summary: Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio arrive in Zaban City guided by the navigator. They are led into a rundown diner where a secret password reveals a hidden elevator plunging deep underground.

segments.voiceover_text: Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio arrive in Zaban City expecting a grand Hunter headquarters. Instead, the streets are crowded with merchants, tourists, and zero signs of the exam.
Their navigator navigates through back alleys and stops outside a greasy diner. Leorio is insulted that the world's most prestigious test hides behind cheap fried food.
Inside, the chef asks for their order. The navigator whispers the secret code, and the chef ushers them into a private back room.
Once the door clicks shut, the entire room drops. It is a secret elevator plunging hundreds of floors deep into the earth.

parts.title: Four Hundred Monsters in the Dark — Part 2

series.summary: Stepping out of the elevator into the subterranean tunnel, Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio receive their badges and meet veteran applicant Tonpa, who warns them about deadly contenders.

segments.voiceover_text: The elevator doors open into a pitch-black subterranean cavern. Four hundred hardened applicants stare back with murderous eyes. Gon is thrilled, but Leorio is terrified.
A strange bean-shaped examiner hands them their number badges. Leorio pins on four hundred three, Kurapika takes four hundred four, and Gon proudly wears four hundred five.
A friendly veteran named Tonpa approaches with a warm smile. He claims this is his thirty-fifth attempt and offers to guide them through the dangers.
Tonpa points out ruthless competitors like the ninja Hanzo and the Amori brothers. Suddenly, an agonizing scream echoes through the entire cavern.

parts.title: Hisokas Bloody Magic and the Poison Toast — Part 3

series.summary: Hisoka dismembers a rude applicant with playing cards, terrifying the crowd. Tonpa attempts to poison Gon and his friends with spiked juice, but Gon detects the poison.

segments.voiceover_text: A panicked applicant collapses as his arms vanish into thin air. He bumped into the wrong man without an apology, and paid with his limbs.
The culprit is Hisoka, a terrifying magician who nearly slaughtered an examiner last year. His sadistic grin leaves the entire cavern frozen in dread.
Tonpa breaks the tension by offering canned juice to celebrate their new friendship. Leorio eagerly accepts, but Gon takes one sip and spits it out.
Gon warns that the drink tastes rotten. Leorio smashes his can in fury, while Kurapika pours his out. The friendly veteran is actually a saboteur.

parts.title: The Assassins Immunity and Tonpas Terror — Part 4

series.summary: Tonpa targets the young rookie Killua with his poisoned drink. Killua drinks it without hesitation and chills Tonpa to the bone by revealing his assassin immunity.

segments.voiceover_text: Exposed by Gon, Tonpa slinks into the crowd searching for an easier victim. He spots a silver-haired boy riding a skateboard alone: Killua.
Tonpa hands Killua several cans of the same lethal laxative juice. Killua chugs the entire drink in seconds and casually asks for another.
Tonpa smirks, waiting for the boy to collapse in agony. Instead, Killua smiles. He reveals he was raised as an assassin and is completely immune to poison.
Tonpa shivers in absolute terror, realizing he just provoked a monster. Before he can run, an ominous bell rings, and the massive stone gate begins to lift.

parts.title: The Endless Marathon into the Abyss — Part 5

series.summary: Examiner Satotz announces the start of the Hunter Exam First Phase. The applicants embark on a grueling subterranean marathon that pushes everyone to their physical limits.

segments.voiceover_text: A tall examiner named Satotz steps through the mist. He has no visible mouth and gives only one instruction: follow him to Phase Two.
Satotz warns that anyone who falls behind is disqualified, and the survival rate is brutally low. Without another word, he begins marching forward.
His mechanical stride quickens into a run, and all four hundred applicants sprint behind him. The dark tunnel stretches endlessly, with no finish line in sight.
Miles pass as weaker runners collapse from exhaustion. Gon and Kurapika push forward, Leorio struggles to breathe, and Killua glides alongside them. The true test has finally begun.
